# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 2: Maritime Warfare, Letters of Marque, Strait Toll CBs & 5 Historical Expeditions (oe_nav2_). Generated by gen_v125_maritime.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Root is declaring country; scope:target is the target country.

# CB 1: Strait Toll Dispute (covers all 6 great world maritime chokepoints)
oe_nav2_cb_strait_toll_dispute = {
	trade = yes
	speed = 15
	war_goal_type = enforce_tariff_exemption

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_ports = yes
		NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:pirate_brethren_reform }
		NOT = { country_type = navy }
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			oe_nav2_controls_major_strait = yes
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			oe_nav2_controls_major_strait = yes
		}
		OR = {
			"tariffs_paid_to(scope:target)" > 0
			scope:target = { is_embargoing = root }
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_nav2_strait_breach_target
				var:oe_nav2_strait_breach_target = scope:target
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					is_rival_of = scope:target
					opinion = { target = scope:target value < -25 }
				}
				scope:target = { has_ports = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		scope:target = {
			oe_nav2_controls_major_strait = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_allied_with = { target = scope:target }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_nav2_strait_breach_target
				var:oe_nav2_strait_breach_target = scope:target
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_NAV2_STRAIT_BREACH_REASON"
				value = 45
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				monthly_trade_income > 0
				"tariffs_paid_to(scope:target)" >= {
					value = monthly_trade_income
					multiply = 0.08
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "TARIFF_DISPUTE_HEAVY_TARIFFS"
				value = 45
			}
		}
	}
}

# CB 2: Suppress Privateers & Escort Trade (universal naval anti-piracy CB complementing vanilla cb_anti_piracy)
oe_nav2_cb_suppress_piracy = {
	trade = yes
	no_spy_network_cost = yes
	speed = 20
	war_goal_type = naval

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_ports = yes
		navy_size > 0
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
		OR = {
			scope:target = { oe_nav2_is_pirate_entity = yes }
			any_market_center_in_country = {
				any_location_in_market = {
					is_land = no
					has_privateers_from = scope:target
				}
			}
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		navy_size > 0
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
		OR = {
			scope:target = { oe_nav2_is_pirate_entity = yes }
			any_market_center_in_country = {
				any_location_in_market = {
					is_land = no
					has_privateers_from = scope:target
				}
			}
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		navy_size > 0
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				navy_size >= {
					value = scope:target.navy_size
					multiply = 1.3
				}
				OR = {
					has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed
					any_market_center_in_country = {
						any_location_in_market = {
							is_land = no
							has_privateers_from = scope:target
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_NAV2_NAVAL_SUPERIORITY_REASON"
				value = 65
			}
		}
	}
}

# CB 3: Protect Coreligionists & Overseas Factories (Age 4+ kingdom/great power extraterritorial defense)
oe_nav2_cb_protect_coreligionists = {
	trade = no
	speed = 12
	war_goal_type = superiority

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		exists = religion
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= 3
			is_great_power = yes
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			exists = religion
			NOT = { religion = root.religion }
			OR = {
				any_owned_location = {
					count >= 3
					dominant_religion ?= root.religion
				}
				has_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_nav2_b_letters_of_marque }
				AND = {
					has_variable = oe_nav2_factory_dispute_against
					var:oe_nav2_factory_dispute_against ?= root
				}
			}
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		is_subject = no
		exists = religion
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			exists = religion
			NOT = { religion = root.religion }
			OR = {
				any_owned_location = {
					count >= 3
					dominant_religion ?= root.religion
				}
				has_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_nav2_b_letters_of_marque }
				AND = {
					has_variable = oe_nav2_factory_dispute_against
					var:oe_nav2_factory_dispute_against ?= root
				}
			}
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		exists = religion
		scope:target = {
			exists = religion
			NOT = { religion = root.religion }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -35
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				within_diplomatic_range = scope:target
				societal_value:spiritualist_vs_humanist < 0
				army_size >= {
					value = scope:target.army_size
					multiply = 1.25
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_NAV2_PROTECT_FAITH_REASON"
				value = 55
			}
		}
	}
}
